admission.justification: Procuring an extra uv would mutate operator-owned tool state and silently reverse the chosen use-the-machine-tool boundary.

applicability: The host worktree environment bootstrap and its selection of the machine-provided uv.
conditions: A supported uv is supplied on PATH by the operator.
exclusions: Installing Python and locked project dependencies is unchanged.
The certified container retains its existing exact uv installation.

evidence: test_script_brings_no_uv_itself; search for curl|wget|download|pip install|uv==|install uv in the script: no match

statement: The product downloads and installs no uv.
